`handoff` moves the **single** mutator grant from the calling namespace to a controller-attested child run as ONE fsynced metadata replace: ownership proof (`_owner_only`), settlement identical to `release` (every WRITE view `PUBLISHED`/`REJECTED`, no `intent.json`), the live writer fd this process opened, then the invariants same session / `target.parent_run_id == caller.run_id` / distinct run. `active_actor` becomes the target while `owner_namespace`, `generation`, `status` and `revision_id` stay byte-identical and a fresh 64-hex capability is minted. **Generation is never advanced** (a handoff is not a new write epoch), so pins and the child's views keep their generation; `parent_run_id` is controller-attested after an actual `begin_run` and the supervisor proves only the link it was told

On the approved filesystem with the installed service and the controller's UID: as the owner, send `handoff` naming the child run an actual `begin_run` allocated in the same session and observe the `{view_ref:null, capability, generation, revision_id}` reply with the generation **unchanged**; confirm the child immediately opens a WRITE view and writes, that the parent's old capability is `UNAUTHORIZED` for fresh work with the canonical tree unchanged, that a same-request-id replay still returns its cached original reply (the new capability) while a new request id with the old proof is `UNAUTHORIZED`; then the refusals, each with `workspace.json` byte-identical: a `SEALED`-but-unpublished view, an `OPEN` view and a present `intent.json` are `WORKSPACE_BUSY`; wrong session, wrong parent, self-target and null parent are `INPUT_POLICY`; a foreign principal or capability is `UNAUTHORIZED`; and exactly one `operations/op-<request_id>.json` ends `DONE` with the capability absent from it. Negative controls: reuse `_claim_generation` (the generation advances and every pinned `view_ref.generation` stops matching), skip the settlement predicate (a handoff while a view is still writable), and check the parent link after the swap (metadata moved, then refused).
